reviewed_interpretation: The single authoritative I036 execution is consumed and terminal, but invalid under its preregistered contract. Dataset identity, fresh seeds, causal target/anchor coverage, fixed 1/2/4/8 horizon coverage, partition accounting, and exact NS/VAD mirrors all passed. The sole invalid reason is the all-bin noise_rms reconstruction gate: maximum observed reconstruction gap 1.52587891e-05 dB exceeded the preregistered 1.0e-05 dB bound by 5.2587891e-06 dB. Source review identifies a diagnostic reduction-order mismatch: shipping ap_ns_process accumulates all 257 noise estimates sequentially in bin order, whereas the I036 mirror accumulated low/speech/high partition sums separately and then combined those partial sums. The observed reconstruction deltas occur on single-precision quantization steps and are consistent with this changed floating-point reduction order. Because the gate failed, all aggregation/spectral response observations are descriptive only and cannot establish or reject an aggregation-domain mechanism. No band, estimator, normalization, alpha, threshold, horizon, lag, mapping, refresh rule, source candidate, HIL or release authority is selected. The consumed I036 run must not be rerun.
